verdict.rationale: Paperspace is a GPU cloud and infrastructure platform (VMs, notebooks, deployments, workflows), not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in AI agent that could act as an MCP client. That users could run their own MCP setups on its VMs is a host-platform capability and does not make the axis apply.
